turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let us look at your feet today.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pulses are good and I see no ulcers.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I check them every night like you said.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Keep doing that. How is the metformin going?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No stomach upset since we lowered it to 500 mg twice daily.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good. We will see you in six months.
